cues.en: Now that we're done with the Dockerfile, let's create the Entrypoint shell script.
cues.zh: Dockerfile 完成後，接著建立 entrypoint Shell 指令稿。

cues.en: The purpose of this entrypoint shell script is going to ensure that you can connect to a Postgres database service before we can spin up our first API web service.
cues.zh: 這個指令稿的目的，是在啟動 FastAPI 網頁服務之前，先確保能連到 Postgres 資料庫服務。

cues.en: So we're going to go to backend Docker local then fast API.
So within the fast API folder we're going to create a new file.
cues.zh: 在 fastapi 資料夾裡新增檔案，

cues.zh: 可以到 start 指令稿，

cues.en: Then let me just copy these lines, then paste it in the Entrypoint shell script.
cues.zh: 複製這幾行，再貼到 entrypoint 指令稿。

Within the Entrypoint shell script, we're going to write a multi-line Python script, which is going to help us connect to the database and wait for it to be ready.
cues.zh: 在 entrypoint 裡撰寫多行 Python 指令稿，協助連接資料庫，並等待它準備好。

cues.en: So how do you do that?
We say Python then with these arrow signs.
cues.zh: 寫 python，再加這兩個箭頭符號，

cues.en: Then you say end like that.
So when we say Python then arrow signs.
cues.zh: python 加上這些箭頭符號，

cues.en: And this allows us to write a multi-line Python script within this entrypoint shell script.
cues.zh: 就能在 entrypoint Shell 指令稿裡撰寫多行 Python 程式。

cues.en: And now within the Python script we can add in some imports from Python.
cues.zh: 現在可以在 Python 程式裡加入匯入。

cues.en: So we're going to import system.
Then again to import time.
Then we're going to import a psycopg like that.
Then we're going to create some three variables.
The first one is going to be the maximum wait time in seconds.
cues.zh: 第一個是最長等待時間，單位為秒。

cues.en: As you can see maximum underscore wait and seconds.
And you're going to set that to 30 like that.
Then the next one is going to be the retry interval.
And that's going to be in five seconds.
And then the start time we're just going to use the time package and say time dot time like that.
cues.zh: START_TIME 則使用 time 套件，呼叫 time.time()。

cues.en: So after that we can create a function call it check database.
cues.zh: 接著建立 check_database 函式。

cues.en: So define check database like that.
This is a normal Python function.
cues.zh: 這是一般 Python 函式，

cues.en: And we're writing it within our script.
cues.zh: 只是寫在 Shell 指令稿裡。

cues.en: That's why we started with this expression of Python.
And like that so that we can write some custom Python scripts in here.
cues.zh: 搭配 END，讓我們在這裡寫自訂 Python 程式。

cues.en: So within our function we're going to have a try except block.
cues.zh: 函式裡放 try／except 區塊。

cues.en: So enter then make sure you tab try then full colon then tab.
cues.zh: 按 Enter，縮排，輸入 try:，再縮排。

cues.en: We can say psycho PG dot connect.
We're going to try and connect to our database.
The database we want to connect to must have a database name.
cues.zh: 要連接的資料庫必須有名稱。

cues.en: So you can say DB name.
And that's going to be from our environment variables.
You can say dollar sign and then curly braces from environment variables.
We're going to bring in the Postgres underscore db.
Remember we had set this in our dot env dot local file.
Then we're going to do the same for the user.
So I can copy that down.
This becomes user.
Then this is going to be Postgres user.
Then the password that becomes Postgres password like that.
Then the host that is going to be the Postgres host.
Then the last one is going to be for the port.
And that's going to be the Postgres port like that.
Then after that we can just return true.
Then at the same level as the try block, we're going to have the except block.
cues.zh: 再於和 try 同一層，加入 except 區塊。

cues.en: And you can say except a psycho PG dot operational error.
So if there are any errors, as you can see, operational error can give it an alias and call it as error.
cues.zh: 若發生錯誤，可以用 as error，將例外命名為 error。

cues.en: So if there are any errors, type it in.
Remember this is Python.
We are writing within our script.
So you have to be careful about the indentation so we can get the elapsed time by creating a variable
cues.zh: 因此要注意縮排。建立變數，取得經過的時間，

cues.en: called elapsed and setting it to integer of time dot time like that.
Then you subtract the start time.
And remember we had set the start time variable up there.
Then if there are any errors we're going to show the user the error.
cues.zh: 若有錯誤，要將錯誤顯示給使用者。

cues.en: So you can see here a standard error dot write.
And using Python f strings we can say here database connection attempt failed.
cues.zh: 用 Python f-string 寫「資料庫連線嘗試失敗」，

cues.en: After then we're going to pass in the elapsed time like that.
Then say seconds.
Then we're also going to display the error.
So in curly braces we can pass in the error.
Then a new line.
Then we can return false like that.
So that is it for the check database function.
Then indent it back to the same level as the function.
cues.zh: 接著退回和函式定義同一層。

cues.en: And then we can say while true we're going to run our function.
cues.zh: 寫 while True，執行這個函式。

cues.en: So type it in.
You can say if check database then we're going to break.
cues.zh: 如果 check_database() 成功，就 break。

cues.en: And then at the same level as the first if block we can say if time, the time minus the start time is greater than the maximum weight seconds, which is right up here.
cues.zh: 接著和第一個 if 同一層，判斷 time.time() - START_TIME 是否大於 MAX_WAIT_SECONDS，就是上面這個。

cues.en: I can just copy it, which is 30s.
cues.zh: 可以直接複製，值是三十秒。

cues.en: Then we're going to write an error so I can just copy this error here.
cues.zh: 若超過，就寫入錯誤訊息。複製這段錯誤輸出，

cues.en: Then right there make sure you indent it, I can paste it in and say system dot standard error dot write.
cues.zh: 貼到這裡，注意縮排，呼叫 sys.stderr.write。

cues.en: And let me change the content.
I can say in double quotation marks error.
Then I can say database connection could not be established after 30s then the new line character.
cues.zh: 再寫「三十秒後仍無法建立資料庫連線」，最後加換行字元。

cues.en: Then we can say system dot exit like that with an error code of one.
cues.zh: 接著呼叫 sys.exit(1)，以錯誤代碼 1 結束。

cues.en: Then at the same level as the if block, we can paste again the error and you can now say system dot standard error dot write with f strings.
cues.zh: 再退回和 if 同一層，加入錯誤輸出，使用 sys.stderr.write 與 f-string。

cues.en: I can get rid of all this and I can say here waiting.
cues.zh: 刪除這些內容，改成「等待」。

cues.en: Then pass in the retry interval.
Where did we write it.
Let me see.
Copy that.
Come back.
Pass in the retry interval in seconds before retrying like that.
cues.zh: 傳入 RETRY_INTERVAL，訊息是「等待這麼多秒後再重試」。

cues.en: Then we can say time dot sleep passing in the retry interval.
We can copy that, then paste it right there.
Then after that we can now end our Python script.
cues.zh: 接著就能結束 Python 程式。

cues.en: So remember we had this Python end.
cues.zh: 記得，開頭使用了 python 與 END。

cues.en: So make sure you have to close it right there.
cues.zh: 所以這裡要用 END 關閉。

cues.en: Then we're going to redirect our output to the standard error by saying the arrow then ampersand then two.
cues.zh: 接著透過 >&2，把輸出導向標準錯誤。

cues.en: We can say echo then single quotation marks.
We can say post gray SQL is ready to accept connections like that.
cues.zh: 訊息是「PostgreSQL 已準備好接受連線」。

cues.en: Then we're going to replace the current process with the new process by saying execute.
cues.zh: 接著用 exec，以新程序取代目前程序。

cues.en: Then in double quotation marks dollar sign, then add like that.
So this dollar sign at passes all the arguments to the entrypoint shell script.
cues.zh: $@ 會傳遞 entrypoint Shell 指令稿收到的所有引數。

cues.en: So when you say execute then dollar sign and we are replacing the shell with the main process.
cues.zh: 所以 exec "$@" 就是以主要程序取代 Shell。

cues.en: So that's what we're doing here.
Then you can save the file.
And so in a nutshell this Entrypoint shell script is just going to ensure that you can start our Postgres database service before we can spin up our other services.
cues.zh: 簡單說，entrypoint 指令稿確保 Postgres 資料庫服務先準備好，才啟動其他服務。

cues.en: So that's the main reason for creating this script.
cues.zh: 這就是建立這個指令稿的主要原因。
